claims.summary: The release is grounded in a fresh deployed v0.15.78 Project Management ZIP/log audit that regraded at 95/A and exported generic Session labels after CourseIR direct authoring fell back.
Course-map readiness repair now rejects Session N, Topic N, and bare numbered lesson labels as generated topic candidates before compilation/export.
A Project Management regression recreates the native recovery failure shape and proves concrete anchors survive while generic Session labels are removed.
The release notes carry forward source-ledger, slide-deck, texture, and local-storage findings instead of claiming a clean 100/100 package.

carryForward.next: Preserve or recover trusted concept-linked source rows when native CourseIR fallback only exports review metadata.
Ensure enriched decks expose at least five content-bearing slides per deck instead of visually rich but text-thin output.
Reduce repeated support-answer and deck phrasing so texture can reach 100/100 without hiding the finding.
Prune or rotate saved conversation state so new runs do not surface Local save failed / QuotaExceeded warnings.
